title: Third Board
tagline: Self hosted and Lightweight alternative to dework with fast, customizable and chain agnostic project management solution for small to mid sized teams and hackers.
description:
a self-hosted and chain-agnostic solution for managing teams. a lightweight and fast alternative to dework that makes it easy for small teams to collaborate without boundaries. built to offer the benefits of decentralized storage and nft gated authentication experiences.
this makes it possible for you to:
deploy you instance on any server
customize your UI according to your brand
use any nft in any chain to token gate you users
connect your github and link pull requests.
leverage any decentralised storage loved by you
how_its_made:
built with polybase and execution machine for efficient data storage.
uses whal3s for nft validation. the nft pass can be hosted on multiple blockchains easily. was made with vite to cater for speed and flexibility. 
integrated with multiple decentralized database solutions to offer more choices on db configuration.
uses blocknative and tailwindcss to allow for 100% UI customizations
